last.verdict: Moderna swung to a $162M quarterly profit and raised its 2026 revenue outlook, but the stronger cash outlook mostly comes from new debt.

takeaways.label: Revenue outlook raised
takeaways.text: Third-quarter revenue rose 29% to $1.3B, driven by international COVID vaccine deliveries. Full-year growth is now seen at 15%–25%, up from at most 10%. Moderna still expects about half of revenue from the U.S.

takeaways.label: Cash boost is borrowed
takeaways.text: Year-end cash is now expected at $8.1–8.3B, up from $4.7–5.2B. The press release ties this partly to $2.6B net from convertible notes, which are debt that can convert to stock.

takeaways.label: Profit with caveats
takeaways.text: Net income was $162M versus a $200M loss a year ago, helped by R&D falling 27% to $583M. Most of the $1.3B in quarterly sales was still uncollected at quarter-end.

takeaways.label: Pipeline progress, mixed
takeaways.text: Melanoma cancer shot intismeran cut recurrence or death risk 42% in Phase 3. The flu vaccine won U.S. approval but launches only in limited form this season; norovirus is stalled.

history.verdict: Norovirus vaccine setback outweighed a smaller-than-expected loss and lower costs.

reasons.label: Norovirus vaccine setback
reasons.text: Phase 3 norovirus vaccine missed early-success bar; more patients must be enrolled, delaying it.

reasons.label: Pipeline over numbers
reasons.text: Revenue is only $145M, so the stock trades on upcoming flu and melanoma news.

reasons.label: Cost cuts, cash runway
reasons.text: Spending outlook trimmed about $0.2B; year-end cash now seen at $4.7–5.2B.
